verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Logseq as a manual outliner/PKM tool with queries, plugins, and an HTTP API, but no first-party AI-generated insights or suggestion features are documented anywhere in the docs. One community comment mentions using Claude/codex to edit pages via a plugin, but that is a third-party workaround, not a native AI capability, and it's actually cited as being lost in a newer version. missing for 10: any first-party AI insight/suggestion feature, docs on an AI assistant panel, evidence of native LLM integration.
